translation: Come on Mikuru, let's hurry!
But, w-we're not allowed to run in the hallway…

The wonders of the world won't just sit still
and wait for us!
So hurry up!
Ehhh—
Um, I found this on the floor…
What's this?
Umm, Kyon said it has computer data in it…
Computer data?

Hmm… Oh, it has Computer Research Society
written on it?
Y-yes.

In that case, it might be something really
important.

You're right. So we'd better give it back to
them…
What are you talking about?!

We obviously have to check what's inside
first!
Huh?! Is that okay?

As if I'd just give back such an interesting
looking thing!
I wonder what's inside…
Suspicious photos, maybe?
Or some kind of dangerous computer virus?

Either way, we've found something we can use
against them!

Um, it might not have anything interesting
inside. It could even be broken…

I'd love to check right away, but let's wait for
Koizumi and the others first.
